subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept `qwen-token-plan` as a bundled qwen provider/auth surface for both Global/Singapore and China/Beijing?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and well-proven, but it adds public provider, auth-choice, env-var, endpoint, and catalog contracts that ClawSweeper should not accept without maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
options.body: After rebase and generated-surface repair, merge this as the official qwen Token Plan provider for both documented regions.

options.title: Narrow The Provider Before Merge
options.body: Ask for a narrower regional or catalog surface if maintainers only want to support the region and models with strongest public/vendor evidence.

options.title: Route Outside Bundled Qwen
options.body: Close or pause this PR and ask for a ClawHub/provider plugin if maintainers do not want another Alibaba provider contract in core distribution.

recommendation.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
recommendation.body: After rebase and generated-surface repair, merge this as the official qwen Token Plan provider for both documented regions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the strongest history signal for qwen provider direction and is the current assignee on the PR.
